name: DesignModel sources
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Design's window: DesignWorkspace (pages, the selected page and node, the tool, the open file's URL), the multi-layer selection (DesignSelection: the ordered selected layers with the last as primary, Shift-click toggling, the box around them), DesignNode (the node tree on a page, each node with a fill and text, in absolute page points) and the tree flattened into rows under the expanded set, DesignHistory (the model-owned undo and redo, one named step per edit; New File's step carries the replaced document's file URL, which Undo puts back), the canvas gestures (hit testing, the handles a selection shows, draw, move, resize, nudge, delete, in DesignCanvasEditing and DesignDrawing), what the canvas shows before a click (DesignCanvasHints: the hover answer, the Text tool's placement box, the size badge and where it hangs), what an arrow, Delete, Escape or Return pressed on the canvas does, ignoring the numeric-pad flag every arrow carries (DesignCanvasKeys), the inline text edit, whose commit fits the box to the measured text in the same step (DesignText), where the canvas puts a frame's name, above the frame or inside it at the artboard's top (DesignFrameLabel), the inspector's header lines (DesignInspectorContent), the lock that covers a node's subtree and the line saying why (DesignLocking), the Layers row's eye and lock toggles, the hidden-in-tree check and the move target a drop above, below or into a row maps to and the insertion line a pointer over a row draws (DesignLayerToggles), the held-id index id minting reads (DesignHeldIDs), aligning the selected layer to its enclosing frame or page with the reason a command is off (DesignAlign), the window toolbar's eight commands with their titles, symbols, identifiers and the reason each can't run (DesignToolbarItems), the page's size as one undo step, its visible content bounds and which layers reach past its edge (DesignPageSize), the file codec (DesignFile), the open document as SuiteKernel's DocumentSession over the history's step serials, a save setting its saved token and ending the edit run, and the file version read through VersionedJSON.probe (DesignSession+Kernel), the export contract (DesignExport+Kernel: the scope and options, the workspace's export targets, plan and SVG readouts over the export slot, and the remembered options, never a history step), what the export sheet reads (DesignExportSheet+Kernel: the scope chips' titles, the options it opens with, a whole 1x to 3x scale, the run's shown options and the file list with skipped hidden layers) and the SVG text of nodes inside a box (Live/DesignSVG), what a PNG of a planned export item draws (DesignRaster: the item's nodes moved to the origin on a page its whole-point size, the plan's pixel size and scale, a side over its max refused), the eyedropper's sample adapter onto SuiteKernel's SampleTarget (DesignSample+Kernel: why nothing can be sampled, the colour of the topmost visible painted layer at a point, and applying it to the selection's fill or stroke as one step), the stroke adapter (DesignStroke+Kernel: a node's stroke as the kernel's VectorStroke, the workspace as SuiteKernel's StrokeTarget with its help, trim refused in Design, and the stroke editor's intents as the inspector's style change), the loupe the eyedropper shows at the pointer and a click's pick (DesignLoupe: the pointer's page point, the colour read there and whether Option sends it to the stroke), the layer tree adapter onto SuiteKernel's LayerTree (DesignNode+Kernel: a node as the kernel's layer payload and back; Live/LiveOrdering's Move Layer and Arrange, Live/LiveGrouping's Group and Ungroup, Live/LiveDuplicating's Duplicate, the Layers rows and the lock cascade run on it, and the refusals map to Design's by layer name), and the use cases a workspace runs on (DesignServices, whose `.live` set is NotBuilt in every slot until each feature lands: each help says the feature isn't built yet and each write refuses; `.fake` is the fixture fakes in Fakes/ that snapshots and fake-mode journeys use), and the workspace actions the window, menus and canvas call (DesignActions: each command's help and run through the services as one named undo step, one-layer delete, nudge and align on today's methods, Zoom to Selection and Select All; DesignActions+Edit: Copy, Cut and Paste, with Paste into the selected frame, Move Layer, and the inspector's style rows as DesignStyleChange, one-layer frame, fill and corner radius on today's methods), the command catalog (DesignCommandCatalog: every DesignCommand, palette tool, page and file action as a SuiteKernel CommandSpec whose availability is today's help and whose run is today's method, under ids kept in Tests/command-ids/design.txt), what the menu bar's items read (DesignMenuState: those specs over the focused window's workspace, with the menus' own rules for Open, a focused field's Undo and Redo, Rename Page and Align), Design's document with no window for the CLI and the real jobs (DesignHeadless: open and save through the file codec, the catalog lifted onto the workspace, SVG export of every page's top-level frames), and DesignLiveEdit: the copy a canvas drag or inspector scrub shows until it ends, then replays into the workspace as one step, and the gradient fill (DesignFill+Kernel: a node's kernel Fill in its unit box, the workspace as SuiteKernel's GradientFillTarget, and runFill, which sends a fill gesture through the catalog).
